excerpts.text:
The [parameters](/ai-coding-dictionary/parameters). [Stateless](/ai-coding-dictionary/stateless) — does [next-token prediction](/ai-coding-dictionary/next-token-prediction) and nothing else. "Claude Opus 4.x" and "GPT-5.x" are models. On its own a model can't do anything agentic; it has to be [harnessed](/ai-coding-dictionary/harness).

Models can't read files, run commands, browse the web, or remember yesterday — it takes [tokens](/ai-coding-dictionary/token) in and predicts tokens out, once per [model provider request](/ai-coding-dictionary/model-provider-request). Everything that feels like an [agent](/ai-coding-dictionary/agent) working — choosing [tools](/ai-coding-dictionary/tool), reading results, looping until the task is done — is the harness orchestrating many of those predictions in a row.

- **Token**：大语言模型读取和生成文本时使用的基本计量单位。一段文字通常会被拆成多个 Token。
- **LLM**：Large Language Model 的缩写，即“大语言模型”，是一类能够理解和生成文本的 AI 模型。
- **Prompt**：你交给 AI 的任务说明或指令文本，中文常译为“提示词”。

### 当前两篇新样本的制作归属

| 页面内容或能力 | 制作步骤及责任 |
| --- | --- |
| 标题、摘要、正文、正文中的中文理解版、原译稿的小词典 | Terra / medium 初译，Sol / medium 编辑后形成当前译稿。流程记录见 `reports/special-agent-token-usage.json`。没有逐句修改记录时，不能将某句错误单独归给 Terra 或 Sol。 |
| 页首学习目标、准备条件、完成检查、相关阅读说明、词典页的一句话理解 | 当前任务的 GPT-6 Astra / xhigh 在“第一步”中新增；尚未经过另一次独立模型审核。任务记录为 `01a0a64d-34d3-7b60-8559-f70d4eadd91f`。 |
| 当前右栏的共享术语定义、别名和概念依赖 | Astra / xhigh 根据原文及已有译稿整理；共享定义优先覆盖原词典，同义词未覆盖的条目仍来自原译稿。 |
| 原始代码、TODO、英文对话 | 来源作者提供；代码按原样保留，Astra 在第一步中补回词典页的英文对话，校验脚本比对出处。 |
| 目录、术语点击、抽屉、代码片段标签、页面布局 | 当前组件由 Astra / xhigh 在第一步中实现或调整；运行时由代码执行，不再调用翻译模型。交互是否符合用户要求由实现与验收负责。 |

以上是两篇新样本的归属，不能把经过反复人工打磨的金标准页面整体归给某一次 Sol 调用。Sol 对原译稿的审核不覆盖后来由 Astra 新增的模块。

Most of the time, you don't just want text back from an LLM—you want that text in a structured format. Imagine generating a story about an imaginary planet, then extracting facts from it as a clean array of strings.

The [AI SDK](https://ai-sdk.dev/docs/introduction) makes this incredibly easy. Instead of asking the model for text and then parsing it yourself (or validating it with a library like [Zod](https://zod.dev)), you can use structured output support built right into the framework.

There are actually two ways to do this in the AI SDK. One approach is more aligned with version 5, the other with version 6—but both work in version 6. Your task is to implement the structured output generation.

- (Optional) Try the alternative approach

Once you've completed the exercise, check if you can implement the version 6 solution using [`generateObject()`](https://ai-sdk.dev/docs/reference/ai-sdk-core/generate-object) instead of `generateText()` with `Output.object()`. Both approaches work, but one is the newer pattern.
